title: Verbs of change: how the cities changed

sections.content: You know *ponerse*, *volverse*, *hacerse*, *quedarse* and *convertirse en* from B1 Unit 25: *ponerse* + adjective is a change that can pass, *volverse* + adjective a deeper change, *hacerse* + noun a change by effort or with time, *quedarse* + adjective a result and *convertirse en* + noun a big change. They fit the new urban societies, where cities, neighbourhoods and classes changed.

items.spanish: Con la migración, la ciudad se convirtió en un lugar muy distinto.
items.english: With migration, the city became a very different place.

items.spanish: Algunos barrios se hicieron más grandes con el tiempo.
items.english: Some neighbourhoods grew bigger with time.

items.spanish: Los sindicatos se volvieron una fuerza importante en la política.
items.english: The unions became an important force in politics.

items.spanish: Un hijo de campesinos se hizo ingeniero.
items.english: A peasant's son became an engineer.

sections.content: Choose the verb by the kind of change: *convertirse en* + noun for a big change (*se convirtió en una ciudad grande*), *hacerse* for a change with time or effort (*se hizo ingeniero*, *se hizo más grande*), *volverse* for a deeper change. Always use the reflexive *se*.
